title.zh: 犹他州总检察长起诉 Kalshi，指控其非法体育博彩并寻求返还资金
title.en: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company

current_state.zh: Utah Attorney General Derek Brown sued Kalshi and affiliates in state court, alleging its event-contract service violates anti-gambling law and constitutes a public nuisance, seeking to block sports, election, political and cultural betting and up to $60 million in damages.
current_state.en: Utah Attorney General Derek Brown sued Kalshi and affiliates in state court, alleging its event-contract service violates anti-gambling law and constitutes a public nuisance, seeking to block sports, election, political and cultural betting and up to $60 million in damages.

updates.title_zh: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company
updates.title_en: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company
updates.what_changed_zh: Utah Attorney General Derek Brown sued Kalshi, its affiliates and two Susquehanna trading companies, alleging the platform has facilitated illegal event-contract betting for over 32,000 state residents since 2024 and asking a court to force the return of about $30–60 million in profits.
